E1301

`flag` expects 2 arguments (name, help), got N

What

`flag` expects 2 arguments (name, help), got N

Why

`ArgsSpec.flag(name, help)` registers a boolean flag like `--verbose`; both the flag name and a one-line help string are required.

Fix

Pass exactly two strings: the flag name and a help description, e.g. `.flag("verbose", "enable verbose output")`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1301: tests/ui/args_spec_bad_flag_arity.stderr.

 Fix: pass exactly two strings: the flag name and a help description
